tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen background behind panels. Night Ops shifts it toward red to protect dark adaptation.

tokens.name: panel-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of every panel, card and the app header. The default reading ground for all text tokens.

tokens.name: panel-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on panels, chips, fields and dividers. Decorative only: 1.25:1 on panel-fill (Standard), so never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: active state, primary CTA, selected tab, slot ring, focused chip. Text in accent on panel-fill: 6.98:1 Standard; 4.06:1 Night Ops (passes only at 19px bold or 24px+).

tokens.name: tx
tokens.usage: Transmit and emergency only: TX marker, TX n/m indicator, unread badge, Emergency and Medical icons, Absent count. Fills and marks; for small text use tx-text (3.73:1 on panel-fill, Standard).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Amber: unknown or degraded state, stations heard in the last 24 h, Pending count. 10.25:1 on panel-fill.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected station and own station (map marker, selected row fill, graph hub). Fills and strokes only; 3.47:1 as text on panel-fill.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, table values, button labels on panel-fill, background and field-fill. 16.7:1 on panel-fill.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Column headers, units, timestamps, captions, empty-state copy on panel-fill and background. 6.24:1 on panel-fill.

tokens.name: rx
tokens.usage: RX waterfall marker and the Online dot. Stays green in Night Ops so RX and TX markers remain distinguishable on a red screen (R21).

tokens.name: tx-fill
tokens.usage: Added 2026-09-29. Red fill that carries white text: Stop button, TX pill, unread badge, waterfall TX tag. White on tx-fill is 5.12:1; white on tx is 4.48:1 and fails 1.4.3 below 19px bold. Reads as the same on-air red.

tokens.name: tx-text
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Small red text on panel-fill (error hints such as 'Connect the USB-C audio adapter'). 5.07:1 Standard, 5.52:1 Night Ops.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Text on a solid accent fill (sent bubble, filled Setup row). 6.1:1 Standard, 5.65:1 Night Ops. The source uses white, which is 3.09:1 on the Standard sent bubble.

tokens.name: field-fill
tokens.usage: Inactive chips, station chip, text fields: background at 60% over panel-fill.

tokens.name: tile-fill
tokens.usage: Small pills and tiles inside a card (condition pills, index chips): white at 6% over panel-fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tab fill under an accent outline.

tokens.name: accent-chip
tokens.usage: Active chip fill; label and 1px border are accent.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row and selected template list row.

tokens.name: row-directed
tokens.usage: Table rows directed to my callsign.

tokens.name: bubble-sent
tokens.usage: Outgoing message bubble fill; text in on-accent. Incoming bubbles use background.

tokens.name: status-recent
tokens.usage: Station dot: heard in the last 15 min. Fixed green in both themes (R15).

tokens.name: status-today
tokens.usage: Station dot: heard in the last 24 h.

tokens.name: status-stale
tokens.usage: Station dot: heard more than 24 h ago. 4.23:1 on panel-fill.

tokens.name: status-indirect
tokens.usage: Station known only through a relay or HEARING report; drawn with a dashed ring or dashed pill border.

tokens.name: status-selected
tokens.usage: Station dot and marker for the selected station and for me.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Added 2026-09-28. Good or ready state of a check, service or tile (icon, border, status word, meter fill). Fixed green in every theme, like rx, so Ready never turns on-air red in Night Ops. 6.98:1 on panel-fill (Standard), 7.6:1 on Night Ops panel-fill. Replaces accent for 'good'.

tokens.name: status-locked
tokens.usage: Added 2026-09-28. Locked or not yet enabled (Transmit locked until the antenna is confirmed). Neutral on purpose: locked is a safe, expected state, not a warning. Always paired with a lock icon and the word Locked.

tokens.name: grey-line
tokens.usage: Solar terminator line and its legend swatch on the globe.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Waterfall Heat palette, noise floor (x = 0).

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Waterfall Heat palette, x = 0.25.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Waterfall Heat palette, x = 0.5.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Waterfall Heat palette, x = 0.75.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Waterfall Heat palette, peak signal (x = 1).

tokens.name: mono-red-peak
tokens.usage: Waterfall Red mono palette peak; black at the floor. Chosen automatically with Night Ops.

tokens.name: mono-green-peak
tokens.usage: Waterfall Green and Digital rain palette peak; black at the floor.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: Added 2026-09-28. The one-word answer on a readiness card (Ready, Locked, Transmitting). One per card, always beside its status icon.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Added 2026-09-28. Title of a detail page or the object a page is about (Elecraft KX2).

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Big numbers and times: Next Net time, Checked In counts.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: App name in the header; conversation callsign.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Every panel title (Band Activity, Waterfall, Net Control).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy, settings rows, empty-state sentences.
styles.sample: Tap a station in Band Activity to start a conversation.

styles.name: subheadline-strong
styles.usage: Chip labels (500), station chip callsign, slot seconds.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Help text under settings, tip cards.
styles.sample: Night Ops picks Red mono automatically.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Column headers, units, bubble meta, pill labels.

styles.name: caption-strong
styles.usage: Pill values, audio route name, section labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Only the 'Next Slot' label inside the slot ring.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Table cells: UTC, offset, SNR, dt, callsign, grid. Digits must align.

styles.name: message
styles.usage: Message text in bubbles and the compose field: exactly what goes on air.

styles.name: marker
styles.usage: Map station pills and waterfall marker labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tab icon to label; title to subtitle.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tab strip gap; icon to value in the battery chip.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dot to label inside pills; bubble meta items.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default gap between siblings; pill padding; field padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bubble padding; station chip and band pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Panel horizontal padding; chip horizontal padding; gap between panels and header items.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Setup card and Radio Weather card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty-state stack gap; large section gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Empty-state outer padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Waterfall marker labels, meter bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: TX bandwidth band on the waterfall.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Map legend and scale bar plates.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Chips, fields, tabs, list rows, station chip, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, header, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Condition pills, map station pills, badges, status dots.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tappable control on every platform.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header row.

tokens.name: tab-width
tokens.usage: One tab in the header tab strip.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: One tab in the header tab strip.

tokens.name: slot-ring
tokens.usage: Next Slot ring diameter.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Condition and index pills.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Status dots in lists, chips and legends.

tokens.name: meter-height
tokens.usage: Added 2026-09-28. Height of a LevelMeter track (receive level with its target range).

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Added 2026-09-28. Primary Button in a card or sheet: one step above tap-target so the one main action is easy to hit with gloves.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Panel, chip and field borders; dividers; dashed frequency markers.

tokens.name: stroke-emphasis
tokens.usage: Own or focused map pill; selected graph node.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Slot ring track and progress.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Chip and button while pressed.

tokens.name: opacity-partial
tokens.usage: A message still being received.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled tab labels (on text-secondary).
